kinds.description: Compiled into the engine. Its config schema is derived by reflection from the Go struct the engine itself parses, so the schema is by construction the one enforced.
A separately-deployed process speaking the connector gRPC contract. Publishes its own config schema; may be newer than this engine. Use for integrations needing real code.
A declarative node defined by data, not code, and interpreted in-process. Publishes its own config schema. Use for calling an endpoint or computing a value.
